text:
alex: Heads-up — support is getting more temporary rate raise requests for demos. Current allowlist flow is manual (support edits TTL on org record). Can we design a safer one-time temporary-lease flow with audit trail + revoke? Thoughts?

maria: +1. Requirements I care about: per-org or per-api-key lease, duration (ttl), maxRPS or token-bucket params, created_by, and an audit_id. Must auto-expire. Also need a revoke path.

joni: We should add guardrails: require support approval for anything >2x baseline or >500rps, log justification, and include rate-change deltas in the audit.

liam: Architecture question — do we implement leases at infra layer (rate-limiter consult) or as an overlay in the API gateway that mutates effective quotas? I prefer infra-level enforcement so it can't be bypassed by older gateways.

supportbot: FYI: last 24h we had 12 temp requests, 3 escalated to eng because audit entries didn't include lease metadata. One caused billing confusion.

alex: Proposed design (sketch): POST /admin/orgs/:org_id/leases -> {duration, rps_limit, scope, reason} returns {lease_id, token}. Token = signed blob (lease_id, org_id, exp, scopes, rps_limit, created_by, audit_id). Enforcement: rate-limiter validates token (highest precedence) then falls back to org defaults. Revocation: DELETE /admin/leases/:lease_id which marks revoked in lease store and emits event to invalidate caches.

maria: Implementation details: lease store should be low-latency (redis with TTL) for enforcement hot-path + append-only changelog (eventstore/kafka) for audit/history. Use redis key "lease:<lease_id>" with fields and TTL. Revocation writes tombstone to changelog and deletes redis key.

joni: Security: only roles in support/sales-ops can create leases from console/API. Add two-step for >8h or >1000rps (manager approval). Also surface lease in console so account owner can see an active lease for transparency.

eva: UX ideas: Console button "Issue temporary burst" with presets: 15m, 1h, 4h, 24h (max). Require short reason, auto-populate contact, show estimated cost impact, and show audit_id + copy-only token. Also include a revoke button next to active leases.

liam: Enforcement detail: pass token via header x-rw-lease or bind to an ephemeral api-key overlay. Header easier for demos. Rate-limiter must account for streaming connections (count tokens across nodes). We'll need a cross-node revocation pub/sub to invalidate lease caches immediately.

maria: Edge-cases: 1) What if lease allows a model not in customer's entitlements? Token should include allowed_models to avoid bypassing permissions. 2) Billing: ensure lease-driven surges are tagged for billing. 3) Long-tail: protect against sales accidentally issuing overlapping leases that sum beyond safety caps. Enforce a per-org max-aggregate lease cap.

alex: Next steps/action items: 1) Formal API + token format doc (alex) 2) PoC redis-backed lease verifier in rate-limiter (liam) 3) Console mock + button flow (eva) 4) Infra plan for cache invalidation + audit pipeline (maria) 5) Sales SOP + revocation playbook (joni). Can we do PoC in 2 weeks?

joni: I'll draft the SOP and a short policy text for "temporary-lease" requests today and share in #product-support.

liam: I'll start a tiny PoC branch that intercepts x-rw-lease header and checks redis. Will ping when I have a prototype.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll open an epic and link it here. Please add comments to the spec once I post. :thumbsup:

supportbot: Created ticket RW-4571 for temporary-lease-flow and added initial checklist (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4571).
